full_supplied_name.label: Exact supplied name
full_supplied_name.definition: The entire supplied name is returned exactly, ignoring surrounding whitespace and decoder control markers. Includes supplied surnames and stage names.

expanded_name.label: Expanded name
expanded_name.definition: A recognizable longer name of the intended person retains the supplied form, e.g. Einstein to Albert Einstein.

full_name_spelling_or_spacing_variant.label: Accent/spelling variant
full_name_spelling_or_spacing_variant.definition: The supplied name is retained with the reviewed accent omission: Beyoncé to Beyonce.

first_name_only.label: Supplied given name only
first_name_only.definition: Only the unchanged given name already present in the supplied name is returned; the remainder is omitted.

surname_only.label: Surname only
surname_only.definition: Only the supplied surname is returned. No cases in this cohort.

shortened_name_or_initials.label: Shortened name
shortened_name_or_initials.definition: A shortened given name or initials are returned. No cases in this cohort.

altered_or_different_name.label: Different name
altered_or_different_name.definition: A different name is returned, as individually reviewed. This descriptive category is not a semantic pass/fail label.

other_response.label: Non-name response
other_response.definition: A List distractor or Friend missing-name statement is returned. No malformed prompt-continuation cases in this cohort.

related_given_name_not_supplied.label: Related given name not supplied
related_given_name_not_supplied.definition: A component of the intended person’s conventional name absent from the supplied name: Orwell to George, Picasso to Pablo, Shakespeare to William, or Dickens to Charles. No pass/fail assigned.

same_person_alternate_name.label: Same-person alternate name
same_person_alternate_name.definition: A different conventional name for the same person replaces the supplied form: Fibonacci to Leonardo of Pisa, in ordinary Visitor.

review_method: Direct inspection of all 1,000 complete continuations by Codex; user approved the reported category tables, including the related-given-name and same-person alternate-name categories.
legacy_entity_in_completion: Unchanged automatic diagnostic from the inference script; not the approved category or a semantic score.
